description: Code of Federal Regulations lookup (eCFR) — Read or search the current US Code of Federal Regulations from the eCFR (updated daily). cite=21 CFR 101.9 returns the section's full text (paragraphs, tables as pipe rows, authority note; max_chars 500-30000, default 8000); cite=21 CFR 101 (or title= + part=) returns the part's section list with headings and subparts; q= searches current regulation text (optional title= filter, limit 1-20) and returns citations, headings, excerpts and links. Public-domain US government data. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: legal_cfr
